content.comment_body: Hello, Does the [product_name] panel backlight activate when its buttons are pressed, and does it stay on for some time afterward? Thanks for any information!
Hi, Yes, this is the default behavior. You can also manage the backlight with a marker or set it to remain constantly on in the panel's settings. Hope this helps.

Hi [user_name], The [product_name] panel backlight can be managed using a specific flag, such as 26. You have options to enable it via buttons or signals. On a specific setup, the backlight stays on continuously.

Great, that's useful information. I've now programmed it so the backlight activates when there's an active alarm, and I've added an off-delay for the marker so the backlight remains lit for some time after acknowledging the alarm with OK. I could actually remove the off-delay because pressing OK achieves the same result. Also, I no longer need to program it to light up when function buttons are pressed. This saves me a lot of effort—thank you!
